generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a small, irregular pine with a rounded to flat-topped crown, stout upturned branches and tufts of short, paired needles at the twig ends. Not fitted to measurements. Cones (plant forms F3): 3 to 6 cm, often closed and kept on the tree for years; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Spray area (plant roadmap P4): the area its card draws now that its needles stand in fascicles.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 11 m tall and 30 cm across at breast height at 40 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: yellow-green needles; dark, thick, furrowed bark. Needle shoots (plant roadmap P4): needles in pairs, 3 to 7 cm long and 1 to 2 mm wide, so a needle 0.03 as wide as it is long (`width`), 2 to a fascicle (`bundle`), from general knowledge of the species, not measured.
